content.title: About
content.content: Soft‑serve frozen yogurt with a rich chocolate flavor is a low‑calorie dessert made from skim yogurt, sugar, and natural flavorings. When churned in a special machine it develops a light, creamy texture, and the addition of melted chocolate gives it a deep, indulgent taste.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Yogurt‑based ice cream contains live probiotic cultures that support gut health.
The chocolate flavor is achieved with real cocoa mass, without artificial colorings.
Soft‑serve is served at about –12 °C, making it softer than traditional ice cream.
In many countries it is considered a healthier alternative to regular ice cream because of its lower fat content.
The soft‑serve technology was invented in the United States in the 1930s and has since spread worldwide.

items.title: Probiotics
items.content: Yogurt provides live bacterial cultures that can improve digestion and support the immune system.

items.title: Low in saturated fat
items.content: Compared with regular ice cream, yogurt‑based soft‑serve typically contains less saturated fat.

items.title: Calcium
items.content: Yogurt is a good source of calcium, essential for strong bones and teeth.

items.title: Chocolate antioxidants
items.content: Dark chocolate is rich in flavonoids, which may protect cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Yogurt supplies vitamin B12 and riboflavin, important for energy metabolism.

items.title: Lactose intolerance
items.content: People who are lactose intolerant may experience discomfort after consuming yogurt‑based ice cream.

items.title: High sugar content
items.content: Some versions can contain a significant amount of added sugar, which should be considered in a balanced diet.

items.title: Milk protein allergy
items.content: Allergy to casein or whey can trigger reactions in sensitive individuals.

items.title: Storage temperature
items.content: Improper storage can cause the product to become grainy and lose its flavor.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve the soft‑serve in cones, waffle cups, or bowls. Top with fresh berries, nuts, honey, or a sprinkle of grated chocolate for extra indulgence.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the product in a freezer at –18 °C or lower. After opening, seal tightly to prevent absorption of other odors. Do not leave at room temperature for more than 30 minutes.
